Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer identifies the largest demographic group at the college in 2020 as "Black/African American" students, making up 80% of the enrollment. The Predicted Answer, however, interprets "largest demographic" as "full-time students" (versus part-time students) and provides percentage data (65%) for full-time students, rather than any ethnic or racial demographic group. Therefore, the substance and vital facts of the Ground Truth Answer (the most numerous ethnic group and its percentage) are not present or addressed in the Predicted Answer.

Decision: FALSE
